title: Ready to Be Your Own Boss? Entrepreneurship for Military Spouses
intro: Military life presents unique career challenges for spouses, including frequent relocations, limited local job opportunities, and inconsistent child care options. Self-employment and entrepreneurship can offer flexibility and career portability—allowing spouses to take control of their professional paths regardless of location.

sections.markdown: If you've ever dreamed of starting your own business, there are programs specifically designed to help military spouses take the next step.

sections.heading: Support Programs for Aspiring Entrepreneurs
sections.markdown:
**[Military Spouse Education & Career Opportunities (MySECO)](https://myseco.militaryonesource.mil/portal/)**

The MySECO program offers an Entrepreneurship Coaching Package to help spouses explore business ownership. Services include:

* The Entrepreneur Edge™ Assessment
* Business plan development
* Identification of potential funding opportunities

Connect with a [SECO career coach](https://myseco.militaryonesource.mil/portal/article/military-spouse-career-coaching-packages) to get started.

**[Small Business Administration Boots to Business](https://sba.my.site.com/s/)**

Boots to business is a two-day course designed for transitioning service members and spouses interested in pursuing their own business.

Contact your installation [Transition Readiness Program](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/marine-family-support/transition-readiness-program) (TRP) to learn more about course availability.

**[Family Member Employment Assistance Program (FMEAP)](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/fmeap)**

FMEAP Specialists provide individualized advising and workshops tailored to entrepreneurial and small business interests.

Visit your local FMEAP office for personalized guidance and resources.

sections.heading: Military Spouse Relicensing and Recertification Reimbursement Program
sections.markdown: Military spouses may be eligible for reimbursement of certain business licensing or recertification expenses incurred due to a Permanent Change of Station. [Learn more.](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/news/marine-corps-boosts-spouse-professional-relicensing-reimbursement)

sections.heading: Take the First Step
sections.markdown: Starting a business can be both empowering and rewarding. If you're ready to pursue self-employment or entrepreneurship, reach out to your installation's [FMEAP](https://www.usmc-mccs.org/fmeap) for support and referrals to available resources.
